title: Debris flow final velocity
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the debris flow's velocity at the bottom of the slope using kinematic equations.

title: Debris flow travel time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for the debris flow to reach the bottom of the slope.

title: Car acceleration time
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for the car to accelerate to the debris flow's final velocity.

title: Safety conclusion
description: Essential: Correctly compares the positions of the car and debris flow to determine if escape is possible.

title: Reaction time inclusion
description: Important: Correctly accounts for the driver's 1-second reaction time in the car's motion timeline.

title: Motion phase analysis
description: Important: Correctly models the debris flow's motion in two phases (accelerated on slope, uniform on flat).

title: Kinematic equation application
description: Important: Applies appropriate kinematic equations (e.g., v² = u² + 2as, v = u + at, s = ut + ½at²) correctly.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s) throughout the solution.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns signs to acceleration or velocity, or confuses the timeline of events.

title: Ignoring uniform motion
description: Pitfall: Fails to recognize the debris flow switches to uniform motion on the horizontal plane.
